Adds a `present` field to the pi-durable `typescript` tool so pi-action's workflow log can show its calls (#372, cv/pi-action#80), and releases it as v0.36.4.

- `present.call(args)`: title from the `// @pit:` label (or `label` argument, else the program's first line); body is the program without its header, then `params` (compact or indented JSON), `functionId`, `saveOnly`. Works on both raw and prepared arguments.
- `present.result(args, result)`: summary is the injected functions (`workspace.read · git.status`), `saved <name>` for saveOnly, or the error's first line; body is the returned value with string fields as they are and other values as indented JSON, with a truncation note when the value was fitted.
